node.name: Scrape the directory
node.description: Fetches the recipe's URL with Clay's scraper (JavaScript rendering when the recipe says so).

inputParameters.name: respectRobotsTxt
inputParameters.description: Check the website’s robots.txt rules. Skip scraping the URL if it is disallowed.

inputParameters.name: waitFor
inputParameters.description: The number of seconds to wait before scraping the website. This gives the javascript in the website time to load. If you find a bunch of results are missing, try adding a delay. Maximum of 10 seconds.

inputParameters.name: keepNonText
inputParameters.description: When scraping body text, we automatically remove any scripts, styles, or images that may be present in the returned text. However, in certain cases, you may want to keep this content. If so, set this to true.

inputParameters.name: outputFields
inputParameters.description: Optionally, select the fields you want to receive in your output data.

inputParameters.name: customRegex
inputParameters.description: Use this field to extract custom data from the website. For example, if you want to extract all of the wikipedia links from the website, you can use https?://([a-z]{2,3}.)?wikipedia.org/wiki/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*

inputParameters.name: enableJavaScriptRendering
inputParameters.description: Many sites dynamically render content with JavaScript. Set this to true to obtain that content.
